scope: Actual frozen production host integration after root GO, no injected adapter/host-context shim. Only native Gamepad API emulation is synthetic.
outputOwnership: Scratch only until archive complete and root authorizes new repository paths.
baselineChecks: Enter repeated after automatic target focus
Ctrl/Meta/Alt E with no unspent confirmation ambiguity
productionChecks: removed target/source and shrinking hand focus
actual final-strike lock and Start safe pause
Y opens actual unspent confirmation without held auto-confirm
complete keyboard campaign plus disclosed pad-activated earned progression
controllerLimits: Emulated standard-pad samples against actual shipped callback integration are browser QA, not physical controller, Steam Input or Steam Deck certification. Visibility emulation is not a real background-tab proof.
references: Frozen v0.5 engine and existing legally generated/validated diagnostic saves. No parallel implementation of input adapter or focus policy.
failurePolicy: Preserve every failed probe/version; diagnostic failures do not silently relax the declared acceptance criteria.
